svg.title: Area under the normal curve for standard sigma intervals
svg.desc: A normal curve with shaded bands between sigma boundaries and six nested horizontal double arrows whose endpoints land on the sigma boundary lines: plus or minus 0.745 sigma is 50 percent, plus or minus sigma is 68.26 percent, plus or minus 1.96 sigma is 95 percent, plus or minus 2 sigma is 95.44 percent, plus or minus 2.58 sigma is 99 percent, plus or minus 3 sigma is 99.73 percent.
